strips.title: A calm Black Friday for tech — in real life

panels.head: Now — the list
panels.text: Write down twelve prices. Several of them already hit their number in October.

panels.head: Nov 19 on — the check
panels.text: Match the exact model, then open the brand store and Walmart beside the deal.

panels.head: The trap
panels.text: "Was $1,499" on a power station that sells for $700 is not a saving. Walk away.

panels.head: Nov 27 on — the buy
panels.text: At or under the number: buy, open the box that week and keep the receipt.
